The '''EL-34 Rotary Plasma Cannon''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
